cd /tmp/ws && python3 << 'PYEOF'
import re

# Test various scenarios with (\S+)
tests = [
    # (pattern, string, expected_group1)
    (r'(\S+) *\s*world', 'hello       world', 'hello'),
    (r'hello\s*(\S+)\s*', 'hello       world', 'world'),
    (r'hello\s*(.*?)\s*world', 'hello  there     world', 'there'),
    (r'(\S+) *\s*world', 'hello world', 'hello'),  # No padding
    (r'hello\s*(\S+)\s*', 'hello world', 'world'),
]

for p, s, expected in tests:
    m = re.match(p, s) or re.search(p, s)
    if m:
        result = m.group(1)
        status = "✓" if result == expected else "✗"
        print(f"{status} Pattern {p!r} on {s!r}: got {result!r}, expected {expected!r}")
    else:
        print(f"✗ Pattern {p!r} on {s!r}: no match")
PYEOF
